dependencies.name: DataForSEO MCP server
dependencies.purpose: Bundled via .mcp.json (dataforseo-mcp-server); powers every SEO/AEO/GEO skill and command (SERP, Keywords, OnPage, Labs, Backlinks, AI Optimization, Domain Analytics, Content Analysis, Business Data). Requires DATAFORSEO_USERNAME/DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD env vars to authenticate — see README Setup.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: Every skill/command that calls a DataForSEO MCP tool fails outright with an auth or connection error — there is no local-data fallback. Still functional without it: the code-seo-review and content-optimize commands, and the content-seo and nextjs-sanity-seo skills (static code/content analysis, no live SEO data).

replacement.suggestion: scrape SERPs, backlinks, and keyword data yourself with ad hoc scripts
replacement.warning: DataForSEO aggregates and normalizes multiple upstream data sources (Google, Bing, backlink crawlers) behind one maintained API. A DIY scraper needs rebuilding every time a search engine changes its markup, and you'd lose DataForSEO's data-quality and dedup work entirely — get a DataForSEO account instead.
